Graduate School
Zurich Graduate School in Geography & Earth System Science
The Graduate School provides a structured program for PhD candidates studying Geography and Earth System Science at the Faculty of Science of the University of Zurich. The Graduate School adminsters the study program, makes recommendations on admissions, delivers obligatory teaching and provides help and advice to PhD candidates and their supervisors. On these pages you can find information about all of these services.
